recordId.description: The match, venue or referee it's on.

contentType.description: What the file is, worked out from its contents.

width.description: Its width in pixels, when the upload gave it.

position.description: Its place among the record's attachments, from 0. A referee's first photo is their picture.

url.description: Where to fetch the file: /v1/attachments/{id}/file, with the same sign-in.

thumbUrl.description: A small version for lists and galleries: /v1/attachments/{id}/thumb (the file itself when none was uploaded).

description: A photo on a match, venue or referee (FILE-1). The files are private: fetching them needs the same sign-in as the rest of the API.
